Results of a CAT session

Source: R/fct_cat.R
cat_results.Rd

The standardized ability of each scale, its standard error, and the percentile: the share of the population of the calibration sample expected below that ability, assuming a normal distribution (pnorm of the standardized ability).

Usage

cat_results(s)

Arguments

s

A CAT session.

Value

A data frame, one row per scale: scale, theta and se (standardized), percentile (0 to 100), answered, total and status.

See also

Other CAT session: cat_answer(), cat_item(), cat_start(), plot_cat_trajectory()

Examples

q <- read_questionnaire(example_questionnaires()[3])
s <- cat_start(q, scales = c("Openness", "Neuroticism"))
while (s$stage == "testing") s <- cat_answer(s, 2)
cat_results(s)
#>         scale      theta        se percentile answered total    status
#> 1    Openness -1.5433321 0.4477210   6.137511        5    10 completed
#> 2 Neuroticism -0.5165523 0.4436883  30.273438        2    10 completed
